lines.1: 「Look at this mess you've made of the futons... All of you, sit in seiza.」
lines.2: 「Sato alone is excused. No matter how you look at it, she seems like the victim here.」
lines.5: 「No whining. Look at Yashi. She's only a first-year, yet she's sitting perfectly upright in seiza.」
lines.10: That took some real talent too.
lines.11: 「I wonder if they're all still sitting in seiza.」
lines.12: 「Looks that way. Then I'll sleep in Ryugu--the student council room.」
lines.13: 「So you really can't sleep when everyone else is around.」
lines.15: 「Yeah. I'd like to go with you, Ellie, but...」
lines.16: 「I'll be fine here. Miss Kurogane might worry if both of us disappear.」
lines.21: 「And that was how the first night of camp passed.」
